criteria.name: Asset Name
criteria.description: Name of the application as it appears on entitlement management systems. A meaningful name is expected. This attribute does not need to be changed. It is written in English.

criteria.name: Asset Description
criteria.description: Text explaining the usage of the application, including key functions and corresponding tasks. Written in generally understandable, business-related language. Targeted at a user without specific knowledge about the application. Does not contain uncommon abbreviations. It is written in English.

criteria.name: Asset Usage
criteria.description: States which user group(s) at application level are allowed to use the access rights of this application (who utilizes the application, where is it used). Should not contain uncommon abbreviations. It is written in English.

criteria.name: Asset Restrictions
criteria.description: Text states any kind of terms and restrictions which influence the application's utilization. Should not contain uncommon abbreviations. Only fill out if applicable. It is written in English.

criteria.name: Authorization Contact
criteria.description: Responsible person for the accuracy and correctness of all attributes around access to the application. The authorization contact should belong to Business organization and not to IT (except for Technical Applications). The authorization contact needs to be present in goto/who is who.

criteria.name: Access Right Name
criteria.description: Name of the access right as it appears on entitlement management systems. A meaningful name is expected. This attribute should not be changed as it means a configuration change with possible functional impact.

criteria.name: Profile Name
criteria.description: Name of the access right profile as it appears on entitlement management systems. A meaningful name is expected. This attribute should not be changed as it means a configuration change with possible functional impact.

criteria.name: Access Right Short Description
criteria.description: Short description of the access right functionality. Must not conflict with access right description. Abbreviations are allowed if they are listed under officially approved acronyms or explained in the Description/Usage field of the Access Right. It is written in English.

criteria.name: Profile Description
criteria.description: Short description of the profile. Must not conflict with Description. Abbreviations are allowed. It is written in English.

criteria.name: Access Right Description
criteria.description: Explanatory and concise text which explains the purpose of the Access Right. Contains information about the functionality (e.g. if Access Mode = Write, what exactly can the user change/modify with this access right). Written in generally understandable, business-related language. Targeted at a user without specific IT knowledge. Does not contain uncommon abbreviations. It is written in English.

criteria.name: Access Right Usage
criteria.description: Text listing the expected users/user groups to have and use this Access Right. Specific functional job descriptions, roles or similar should be provided. Has to be consistent with Usage defined on Asset level. Should not contain uncommon abbreviations. It is written in English.

criteria.name: Access Right Criticality
criteria.description: Weighing of the sensitivity of the data and/or the system accessible by the access right. Must be aligned with the Application Criticality.

criteria.name: Access Mode
criteria.description: Text describing the privilege granted to the user by the Access Right, i.e. Write, Read or Manage.

criteria.name: CID Access Type
criteria.description: Reflects the type of Client Identifying Data accessed by the access right. Needs to be in line with the application's definition in SERA.

criteria.name: Bulk CID Access
criteria.description: Indicates if country-specific Bulk CID definitions are met (see ECMS Handbook) and can be accessed/generated with the access right.

criteria.name: CID Classification
criteria.description: Level of confidentiality assurance required for CID accessible with this access right. Examples: None, Confidential, Strictly-Confidential.

criteria.name: Information Barrier Restriction
criteria.description: The attribute reflects the applicable information barriers restriction. Primarily applicable for IB. See goto/infobarrier for more information.

criteria.name: Cross Border Access
criteria.description: Reflects from which countries outside the data-owning jurisdiction the data can be accessed.

criteria.name: Access Type
criteria.description: Text describing the level/range granted by the Access Right (data versus function).

criteria.name: ONO/ODP Approvals
criteria.description: Correct reference to applicable ODPs.

criteria.name: ONO/ODP Countries
criteria.description: ODP countries according to the ODP request.
